name: Occam's LGS
aliases: Language Gaussian Splatting via weighted multi-view feature aggregation
definition: A training-free method for lifting 2D language features to 3D Gaussian representations. It avoids expensive iterative optimization in feature space by using a probabilistic formulation of the Gaussian Splatting forward process to compute weighted multi-view feature aggregation.
summary: Occam's LGS is a training-free method that lifts 2D language features to 3D Gaussians via weighted multi-view aggregation, avoiding expensive iterative optimization and outperforming sibling methods in speed.
